messages:
Maya: CI blocked on release/v2.3.1, SAST flagged what looks like a hard-coded keystore usage in infra/keystore_client.go — blocking-pr #4521 :grimacing:
Ben: Scanner log shows it couldn't decrypt the artifact so heuristic triggered. error: `kms_decrypt error: PERMISSION_DENIED`
Ben: pipeline snippet:
```
> time=2026-03-20T17:02:13Z component=sast-scanner service=scanner-01 msg=\"kms_decrypt failed\" err=\"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/keystore: PermissionDenied\"
```
Frank: Two asks: (1) capture audit entries for attempted decrypts, (2) do NOT add a global suppression. Use ephemeral grant for scanner-sa, re-run and gather evidence, then revoke.
Alexa: If it's a FP we can add a scoped suppression (repo:infra, rule:SAST-KEystore-001) with owner and TTL, but attach evidence bundle first.
sec-bot: Audit entry found for requestId=ai-98765:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-20T17:02:13Z","principal":"serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com","action":"cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt","resource":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/keystore","status":"PERMISSION_DENIED"}
```
Ben: scanner-sa lacks cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt on that key. We rotated keys last night maybe tightened ACLs.
Liu: Confirmed we rotated last night as part of keystore hardening and only kept deployer-sa + keystore-ops. scanner-sa was missed in allowlist. my fault.
Maya: Plan: ephemeral decrypt permission for scanner-sa for 30m, re-run SAST, attach artifact + decrypted contents to SEC-917, then revoke. No permanent RBAC change until triage complete.
Frank: Runbook steps to execute: 1) DevOps-Bot grant --sa=scanner-sa --key=keystore --role=roles/cloudkms.decrypter --expiry=30m 2) re-run CI 3) collect evidence bundle 4) revoke grant. Keep me looped.
DevOps-Bot: Command received: `grant --sa=scanner-sa --key=keystore --role=roles/cloudkms.decrypter --expiry=30m`  ephemeral grant created, expiry at 2026-03-20T17:32:13Z :white_check_mark:
Ben: Re-ran pipeline, SAST finished, keystore usage is legitimate (env var + client lib)  flagged as FP. Evidence attached to SEC-917 (artifact + scanner decrypted output + pipeline logs).
Maya: Good. Please add a file-level comment in infra/keystore_client.go and a small unit test to avoid future heuristics. Also update the keystore rotation runbook to include scanner-sa allowlist step.
Alexa: I'll create a suppression: rule=SAST-KEystore-001, scope=repo:infra/path:infra/keystore_client.go, owner=infra-team, ttl=7d, attach evidence.
Frank: Add long-term items to post-mortem: root cause (rotation communication gap), short-term (ephemeral grant + scoped suppression), long-term (automate allowlist update in rotation playbook + audit alert if scanners lose decrypt perms). Assign owners.
Liu: I'll update rotation playbook to add automated check: verify scanner-sa is in key ACLs before rotation proceeds, and add a CI gate that fails rotation PR if check fails.
Maya: Action items (SEC-917): Ben: attach evidence bundle + logs (done). DevOps: revoke ephemeral grant at expiry (or sooner). Liu: update rotation playbook + add allowlist CI check. Alexa: create suppression with TTL and owner. Frank: schedule post-mortem sync in 24h and own alert rule.
Ben: small aside  noticed an unrelated flaky DAST test during re-run; opening a separate thread so we don't block this release.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
Frank: reminder: do not change Prod key ACLs during business hours without scanner checklist / comms.
DevOps-Bot: Ephemeral grant expiry reached at 2026-03-20T17:32:13Z, revocation verified.
